title: Silukkuvarpatti Singam
desc: Police constable Shakthi prefers a laid back approach to his job and tries to actively stay away from danger. But he is forced to change this attitude when he inadvertently jails a wanted don.

title: Lubber Pandhu
desc: Anbu faces opposition as he joins a local cricket team. His rivalry with Gethu, a veteran player, creates tension that challenges their ambitions and relationships.

title: Nandhi Varman
desc: Paranormal activities begin to happen when a crew starts excavating a temple that is believed to be concealed beneath the earth.

title: Dragon
desc: After a harrowing break-up, a man becomes increasingly ambitious and begins committing fraud to gain more power.

title: Vinaya Vidheya Rama
desc: Facing a menacing criminal kingpin, Ram fights to protect his family. Soon, he embarks on a daring mission to topple the villain and dismantle his corrupt empire.
